benchmark_sample_summary.label_independence: Partially independent. Positive pilot labels derived from human-audited M3/M6 ground truth; negative candidate labels generated with generator-verifier separation but pending authoritative institutional policy adjudication.

platt_scaling.justification: Fitting 2-parameter logistic sigmoid on N_neg=21 and N_pos=33 is statistically underpowered. With small sample sizes, Platt scaling exhibits high parameter variance (instability in slope A and intercept B) and severe probability compression. Authorized strictly as an exploratory curve-fitting baseline; cannot be reported as production confidence probabilities.

score_calibration.justification: Isotonic regression requires N >= 200 samples to prevent step-function overfitting on sparse rank points. Blocked for Phase 4.

threshold_selection.method_name: Empirical ROC / Youden J Index Threshold Selection
threshold_selection.justification: Feasible to explore optimal operating points on CECI and raw retrieval scores. However, threshold selection on N=54 will overfit query-local quirks unless heavily regularized.

nested_cross_validation.justification: In a 5-fold CV with N_neg=21, each test fold contains only ~4 negative samples. A single misclassification shifts fold recall by 25%. Cross-fitting variance will be large. Permitted only with explicit confidence intervals and exploratory caveats.

calibration_performance_reporting.method_name: Brier Score, Expected Calibration Error (ECE), and Reliability Diagrams
calibration_performance_reporting.justification: ECE with 10 bins would average only ~5 samples per bin, producing noisy bin-level confidence estimates. Authorized with 3-5 coarse bins and exploratory labeling.

overall_recommendation.justification: The benchmark has successfully expanded from N_neg=2 to N_neg=21 qualified negatives (+ 6 answerable controls, 6 needing adjudication), unlocking preliminary calibration exploration. However, the statistical sample size remains too small for definitive production calibration guarantees. Phase 4 is authorized strictly as an exploratory engineering study with mandatory overfitting disclaimers.
